individual-data-points.explanation: Spatial deconvolution plots are heatmap-style color overlays on tissue coordinates, a plot type exempt from requiring individual data points.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Spatial heatmap plots show continuous color-coded values per spot; no error bars are present to define.

individual-data-points.explanation: Box plots show overlaid individual data points (dots) for each sample alongside the summary distribution.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: The box plots represent the distribution of values for each group, extending from the 25th percentile to the 75th percentile; T11b-high LUSC: Classical monocyte (minima=0.00035, median=0.32265, maxima=1, Q1 = 0.16193, Q3 = 0.52806)... [full minima/median/maxima/Q1/Q3 values given per group in caption]
error-bars-defined.explanation: Box plot whiskers and boxes are explicitly defined in the caption with percentile, minima, maxima, median, Q1 and Q3 values for every group.

individual-data-points.explanation: GSEA enrichment score plots are line plots, a type exempt from requiring individual data point overlay.

error-bars-defined.explanation: The enrichment score curves show no error bars or variability indicators to define.

individual-data-points.explanation: Bar graph displays log2 fold-change values per gene from DEG analysis without any overlay of underlying individual data points.

error-bars-defined.explanation: The bar graph shows single fold-change values per gene with p-values annotated; no error bars are drawn to require definition.

individual-data-points.explanation: Panel E consists of H&E and IHC micrographs, not a plot.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Panel E consists of micrographs, not a plot, so error bar definition does not apply.
